description: Workflow Health scans scenario-owned BAS assets into a stable catalog that separates validation cases, agent-runnable flows, and reusable action fragments.

requirements.title: Catalog BAS Cases, Flows, Actions, Seeds, and Registry Metadata
requirements.description: The workflow catalog scanner must read `bas/cases`, `bas/flows`, `bas/actions`, `bas/seeds`, and `bas/registry.json` for a target scenario and emit deterministic asset records with stable IDs, canonical paths, asset type, metadata, requirement links, selector refs, route refs, safety profile, and dependency edges.

validation.notes: Scanner golden tests cover cases, flows, actions, seeds, stale registry entries, missing registry entries, selector references, route references, subflows, and legacy/current BAS node shapes.

requirements.title: Classify Assets by Workflow Role
requirements.description: Workflow Health must classify every BAS asset as a validation case, agent flow, dependency fragment, seed, or registry-only/stale entry so downstream validation, search, execution, and UI surfaces cannot confuse tests with runnable actions.

validation.notes: Catalog fixture tests assert `bas/cases` become validation evidence, `bas/flows` become agent flow candidates, and `bas/actions` are hidden fragments unless explicitly requested.

title: Workflow asset catalog
